name: Kierim Visinhiriiev, collaborating with ODVs Art Studio
statement:
Kierim Visinhiriiev, based in Hollywood, Florida, USA, is collaborating with ODVs Art Studio (Toronto, Canada) for the NewBo City Market indoor mural. ODVs Art Studio works in spray paint and airbrush on large-scale murals, including murals for around 20 Sobeys grocery stores across Ontario, a 3D illusion mural ($50,000, 2014), the Kings Court basketball mural (2024), the Dragon Car Wash mural (2023), and the Green Press mural in Port Credit (2024), as well as the Sultan Fitness gym mural (2026).

The proposal is $19,000 all-inclusive, covering artist fee, travel, lodging, and materials. Online portfolio: https://odvsart.com, Instagram @odvs_art_studio.
